scripts.title: Fix It Up | Auto Farm, Auto Repair, Car ESP | Mobile Support
scripts.features:
Fix It Up script by HanamiHub.

- Auto Farm: buys a junk car, repairs it, drives the kilometres, sells it. Then the next one
- Rhythm mode farms in sessions with breaks and server hops
- Auto Repair on the part machines
- Wash Car and Paint, any colour and finish, Metallic too. The car goes back where it was after
- Car ESP by rarity. Pick what to show and what never to buy
- KM Per Car, Drive Speed, Stop At Money
- Configs with autoload, anti AFK, auto rejoin
- Clean menu with themes
- Mobile support

Bugs and ideas: discord.gg/b8sh3XtAM

scripts.title: Chams Teleport ClickTP
scripts.features:
Open Source: The script is completely open-source. Feel free to review, modify, or integrate the code into your own projects.

Vehicle Chams: Common vehicles feature a simple outline. Rare vehicles (spawn chance 1% and below) are highlighted with a solid bright red fill, clearly visible through walls.

Spawn Percentile Labels: Floating text labels above all vehicles showing "Body" and the exact spawn percentage.

Rare Spawn Alerts: On-screen notifications triggered immediately when a vehicle within the 0.1% – 1% range spawns.

TP Best Car: Intelligent logic that scans the map and teleports the player to the rarest available vehicle.

Location Teleports: Quick-access teleport menu for major locations including Junkyard, Bank, Shop, and Garage.

Click TP: Instant teleportation to the cursor position while holding Left Control.

Junkyard Timer: Real-time countdown synced with the server-side respawn clock.

Gold Counter: Automated balance display calculating total gold based on the in-game cash ratio.

Safe Unload: The Delete key terminates all active threads, destroys the UI, and removes all chams/highlights from the game world.
